comments.author: Sabion
comments.body: Discovery is at Zambezi River Midstream (2nd zone of Africa Southeast Coast). Use search/recognition at the northern most point

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Fixed, thanks for the info. It's funny, the original quest directions for this discovery and the Sahara were accurate, but then new zones dedicated to those very spots were introduced, thus changing the quest discovery steps a bit. The same will likely happen in the future with Niagara Falls.
